sentimento.text1: The presidential book has accumulated USD 139.76M and the price on this page comes from the confirmed reading of Aug 30, 4:40 PM BRT (7:40 PM UTC). NO NEW NATIONAL POLL WAS RELEASED THIS SUNDAY. The most recent one is still Vox Brasil of Aug 29 (BR-05519/2026, fieldwork Aug 25 to 27, n=2,100).
sentimento.text2: On price, the runner-up rose 1.75pp, to 41.10%, the largest move among the panel's names this round, and the leader did not move, staying at 55.50% for a second day. The distance between the two fell to 14.40pp, the narrowest since Jun 10, and the runner-up's price is his highest since May 13.
sentimento.text3: The first-round second-place and third-place contracts publish numbers again this round, after one round without a new reading: the runner-up sits at 85.50% to reach the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and Caiado leads the third-place contract at 43.50%, the same name that sits at 0.15% in the outright-winner contract.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 41.10% (vol USD 9.31M) in the presidential contract, up 1.75pp, the largest move among the panel's names this round, and 85.50% in the first-round second-place contract. In Vox of Aug 29 he has 34.8% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 45.1% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), ahead by 0.6 point inside the margin.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 55.50% (vol USD 9.50M), no change for a second day. In Vox of Aug 29 he has 37.1% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), ahead by 2.3 points, and 44.5% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), behind by 0.6 point inside the 2.15pp margin.
sentimento.terceiraVia: Ronaldo Caiado is the third name in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in Vox of Aug 29, at 5.0%, and in the outright-winner contract he sits at 0.15% (vol USD 6.97M), below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. In the first-round third-place contract he is the leading name, at 43.50%. Augusto Cury gave up 1.40pp in the outright-winner contract, to 1.85%, the largest drop among the panel's names this round.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of Aug 30, 4:40 PM BRT (7:40 PM UTC). AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, taken eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20 point. The presidential book has accumulated USD 139.76M.

inss.text1: The case involving the president's son stayed in this Sunday's news through a new front. A friend of his struck a deal with the prosecution service to avoid arrest for corruption, according to Veja. The investigations rest mainly on messages, trips and closeness to lobbyists, according to Folha de S.Paulo.
inss.text2: The postal service, which is at the centre of the inquiry into the lobbyist's activity, closed the second quarter with a loss of R$ 2.4 billion and has accumulated R$ 5.5 billion in losses this year, according to Valor Econômico. The government will include a R$ 6 billion injection into the state company in the 2027 budget and says the measure brings more stability, according to O Globo.
inss.text3: On the political side, the president's allies tried to contain the lobbyist after he called her a crook, according to Folha de S.Paulo, and his defence avoided questions about his son's role during the campaign schedule.
inss.text4: The case is still live and unresolved. The distinction the panel has kept from the start still holds: the effect on the government's approval is one thing, the effect on voting intention is another, and the two do not add up.
inss.impactoLula: Not isolable, and there is no new reading to measure it. No national poll was released this Sunday, and Vox Brasil of Aug 29 has fieldwork from Aug 25 to 27, before this weekend's events. The eight national polls registered for Aug 31 to Sep 3 are the first that can reach the period.
inss.impactoGestao: No new reading this Sunday. The standing reference is still Vox Brasil of Aug 29, with 52.7% rejection of the president, according to CNN Brasil, and 53.3% disapproval, the highest level of the year, according to Exame.
inss.conclusao: On Aug 30 the case advances through the judicial route, with the deal between the president's son's friend and the prosecution service, and through the fiscal route, with the postal service's loss and the announced injection. Neither has a ballot reading that reaches it yet, and the panel does not attribute any price move to them.

bancoMaster.text1: This Sunday brought no new fact in the case. The day's news collection returned zero items on the query dedicated to the topic, and what exists is from the day before: Daniel Vorcaro's first testimony of the year was concluded on Aug 28, with broad clarifications and a search for a plea deal, according to Folha de S.Paulo.
bancoMaster.text2: The prosecutor general's complaint about his plea-deal attempts is from Aug 29, according to Folha de S.Paulo, and the Dark Horse contradictions over the money and the missing accounting are also from the day before.
bancoMaster.text3: The case entered the campaign on Friday from both sides, and this Sunday it had no development of its own. The runner-up dodged the subject in his TV Globo interview, according to Folha de S.Paulo.
bancoMaster.conclusao: THIS ROUND HAS NO NEW FACT IN THE CASE, AND THAT IS DECLARED. What the panel shows is the picture from Aug 28 and 29, with the date of each piece in the text. The willingness to negotiate a plea deal is still the element that could change the type of risk in the case, and it did not advance publicly this Sunday.

stf.toffoli: HE IS THE COURT'S NAME IN THIS SUNDAY'S COVERAGE, THROUGH A SATURDAY ACT. Dias Toffoli signed a ruling on Saturday, August 29, pulling Renan Santos and running mate Aroldo Medina’s candidacy registration off the docket of the virtual plenary session set for August 31. He pointed to signs of illegality because the ticket filed 18 social media profiles on August 19, with the registration request submitted on August 7, outside the legal deadline. The decision became public on August 30, with seven outlets publishing between 3:47 PM and 6:56 PM Brasília time, among them G1, O Globo, Estadão and Poder360.
stf.moraes: No new individual action captured on Aug 30.
stf.gilmar: He barred the judges' union from charging a fee on the eve of an assembly on ethics rules at the court, according to Estadão, and limited contributions from the judges who joined the union, according to Poder360.
stf.dino: No new individual action captured on Aug 30.
stf.mendonca: No new individual action captured on Aug 30, after four consecutive days as the most cited name at the court.
stf.nexo: THE COURT ENTERS THE ELECTION THROUGH THE REGISTRATION DOOR. The [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) begins ruling on August 31 on the candidacy registrations of Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Zema and Renan Santos, according to Veja, and Renan Santos's has already come off the docket through a ruling dated August 29. In Congress, proposals to rein in the Supreme Court are multiplying and stalling under Alcolumbre, according to Gazeta do Povo. On its own docket this week, the court may rule on Funrural, free legal aid and the ITBI property tax, according to Valor Econômico.
stf.analise: The contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving through impeachment before 2027 sits at 3.60% (vol USD 84 thousand), up 0.15pp in the confirmed reading of Aug 30, 4:40 PM BRT (7:40 PM UTC). It is the smallest book on the panel, and its price did not follow the volume of court activity this weekend: the registration pulled off the docket by a ruling dated August 29, Gilmar Mendes's two decisions on the judges' union and the registration rulings starting on August 31 moved the contract no more than 0.15 point.
